note: Original names and design values for the remake (docs/REMAKE_PLAN.md §4). Source facts come from docs/paladog-*.md; everything here is [추정] or presentation only.

decisions.D-ANIM-01: Attack animation frames when undocumented: max(hitFrame + 4, 10).
decisions.D-NAME-01: All display names are original; research names never ship in src/.
decisions.D-MACE-09: Food weapon: food += int(4 + 0.3g) then clamp to max (E03 §3.1 GetMaceFood; E04 §1-5 cites the clamp line).
decisions.D-UNIT-56: Unit 5 = monkey, unit 6 = turtle by code position; A13 table labels N5/N6 are purchase order (E02 §1.4, E05 B2).
decisions.D-QUEST-01: Per-stage quests are generated by tools/build_remake.py from questRules (quest.xml not in the research docs).
decisions.D-SLOT-01: Account + 3 slots; each slot has a heroKind chosen at creation.
decisions.D-UNLOCK-01: Survival unlocks after clearing paladog stage 12.
decisions.D-REVIVE-01: Campaign revive costs 20 gems, once per battle; survival revive 20 gems (E04 §2-5).
decisions.D-ANIM-02: Hero weapon motion 18 frames, effect on frame 8 (hero part animations not parsed).
decisions.D-PROJ-01: Straight projectile hit half-width 10 px (sprite width not in the data).
decisions.D-GHOST-01: Ghost enemies advance their 150 px untargetable leg at walking speed.
decisions.D-CAP-01: Server protection caps: 80 allies, 120 enemies, 256 moving objects and 256 traps (the original has none). Hero skills do not consume ally slots.
decisions.D-LVUP-01: The battle pauses while a level-up choice is pending, like the original popup.
decisions.D-LVUP-02: Fixed level-up candidates apply when the newly reached level is a multiple of 5.
decisions.D-DESTINY-01: Destiny forced weapon grade equals the forced unit level (1, 3, ..., 19).
decisions.D-DESTINY-02: Destiny boxes are free: no food or mana.
decisions.D-DESTINY-03: Destiny stages summon only through boxes.
decisions.D-WAGON-01: The escort wagon rolls at its row speed unless an enemy body touches its front.
decisions.D-TOWER-01: Tower button 0 summons the chosen unit on all five lanes, button 1 five of it on one lane, button 2 heals all allied units to full.
decisions.D-TOWER-02: The tower mid boss holds lane 3.
decisions.D-REVIVE-02: An unanswered revive offer gives up after 10 s.
decisions.D-SAVE-01: Profile validator bound raised to 16384 nodes / 262144 conservative bytes for the v2 worst case (DataStore limit 4 MB).
decisions.D-SHOP-01: Helmets/armor/mounts cost gems at a base of 100..500 by item number; their gold sale value is base + base*0.1*grade^2.
decisions.D-DROP-01: Drops are a hero weapon or ring/amulet (50/50), number 1..10, grade (chapter-1)*2 + 0..2 capped by the grade limit, seeded per run.
decisions.D-DROP-02: An item that does not fit the 100-slot inventory is sold on the spot.
decisions.D-QUEST-02: Sub quest 1 time limit = floor((iCrSec + 120) / 10) * 10 seconds (matches the 1-1 example of 5:20).
decisions.D-QUEST-03: Shadow quests use the light totals; main = mode goal (19 finish line, 20 siege horse destroyed, dungeon 60 kills), sub2 = coins >= iCSp21 on jump, hero HP >= 50% on horse/dungeon, totem summons on the cycle.
decisions.D-UNLOCK-02: The shadow hero also unlocks from the gem shop for 1000 gems (the original sets the flag from a shop purchase, price unknown).
decisions.D-ANIM-03: Shadow sword swing 15 frames, effect on frame 6.
decisions.D-SHADOW-01: Transform plays a 1 s pose, then the 30 s buff.
decisions.D-SPIKE-01: Spike skill strikes three points 60/120/180 px ahead.
decisions.D-TOTEM-08: Salamander totem lobs a 30 px flame burst at its target.
decisions.D-DUNGEON-01: Dungeon is one lane: hero fixed at x 32, enemies from x 480.
decisions.D-DUNGEON-02: Traps land 80 px ahead of the hero.
decisions.D-DUNGEON-03: Dungeon auto-attack is a free dark sword swing every 0.5 s.
decisions.D-JUMP-01: Jump tracks are original: 64 px tiles, spikes 260..420 px apart away from safe zones, coins spread evenly; finish = last safe tile + 12.
decisions.D-JUMP-02: A jump lasts 0.6 s; a grounded boar on a spike restarts at the furthest safe zone after 1 s.
decisions.D-SWORD-04: Poison dagger creates a one-second cloud with 25 px radius at the arrow hit, refreshing the documented ten-second poison without resetting its damage timer.
decisions.D-JUMP-03: The original runner speed is unknown: runner uses 90% of the boar speed, stopping at the finish. Coins use horizontal swept pickup during grounded or airborne movement (original tile geometry unavailable), so all coin goals are attainable.
decisions.D-3D-01: User-approved 3D companion combat: server X/Z ground-plane geometry, original food/mana economy, summons 30 px behind hero with +/-12 px spread; corridor depth +/-90 px, normalized diagonal speed.
decisions.D-3D-02: Presentation only: 1 px = 0.12 studs; behind-hero Scriptable camera offset (-22,14,0), WASD movement and Q/E/R or left-click magic. Models are original client-only anchored code geometry; server snapshots own movement/damage.
